name: Device Kit
description: Device info, clipboard and app/URL launching via broker capabilities.

tools.name: device_info
tools.description: Read device status: battery percentage, charging state, screen on/off. No grant needed beyond the 'device' capability.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL on the phone (Android VIEW intent), e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Launch an installed app by package name, e.g. com.sankuai.meituan

tools.name: copy_text
tools.description: Put text on the phone's clipboard.
